title: Conference programme and abstracts
author: Poisson 2024 organizers
summary: The 23-page booklet records the schedule, plenary abstracts and posters. Page 2 gives the timetable; pages 3–11 cover talks; pages 12–23 cover posters.

title: Post-groups, post-groupoids and the Yang–Baxter equation
author: Yunhe Sheng · Jilin University
summary: The title page dates the talk to 10 July 2024. The outline connects post-groups to Rota–Baxter operators, braces, Butcher groups and solutions of the Yang–Baxter equation.
notes: Page references use PDF pages, including repeated slides; the printed slide counter differs.

title: Symplectic groupoids via 2-shifted Lagrangian structures
author: Henrique Bursztyn · IMPA
summary: The handwritten title slide credits joint work with D. Álvarez and M. Cueca. The second page frames the lecture around shifted symplectic structures for Poisson geometry.
notes: Title pages visually checked. The PDF contains handwritten image slides; automatic text extraction is unavailable.

title: Conference programme and abstracts
author: Poisson 2022 organizers
summary: The 43-page booklet contains the conference introduction, daily schedule and talk abstracts. The first conference day is listed at ICMAT; subsequent days are listed at the CSIC Central Building.

title: Official conference schedule and event record
author: Fields Institute
summary: The official record includes daily talks, the Earth Sciences Centre lecture venue, and the reception and poster session at the Fields Institute.
notes: Text extracted from the official event page; it includes historical participant affiliations.

title: Global aspects of quasi-Poisson geometry
author: Daniel Álvarez · IMPA
summary: The opening slides outline quasi-Poisson manifolds, associated Lie algebroids and global counterparts, with applications to Picard groups and Courant algebroid integration.
notes: The original host returned an error when a local copy was requested. The original PDF is offered as a source exception; no local PDF copy is claimed.

title: Chern–Simons theory and generalized Kähler geometry
author: Marco Gualtieri
summary: The official talk listing describes the integration of generalized Kähler structures using holomorphic symplectic 2-groupoids and Chern–Simons theory.
notes: The original host returned an error when a local copy was requested. The original PDF is offered as a source exception; no local PDF copy is claimed.

title: Exercises in Poisson geometry
author: Eckhard Meinrenken · Toronto
summary: Exercises cover Poisson brackets, Poisson submanifolds, the Schouten bracket, Poisson–Lie groups, Lie algebroids and Lie groupoids.
notes: This exercise sheet was linked from the official 2016 summer-school course page.
